name: Call of the Mountain buff requires level 40 (#7209)
contract: Call of the Mountain (680406) is a Level 40 passive (CharacterAdvancement 9216, RequiredLevel 40): reaching 5 stacks of Earth's Rage (806068) must not grant the Mountain buff (680472) before level 40, even when the passive is present. A level-34 Primalist holding the passive and stacked to 5 must stay buff-free; after leveling to 40 the same 5-stack crossing must grant it.

steps.label: Fixture: hold the level-40 passive early
Earth's Rage stacked to 5 at level 34
The threshold still grants the buff at 40
